items.text: Threw his 540th career TD pass, passing Peyton Manning (539) for 3rd all-time behind Tom Brady (649) and Drew Brees (571). Also joined Brady as the only QBs with 20 wins at age 40+, and his 115th win vs. NFC teams tied Brees for the most ever.
Caught Aaron Rodgers' record-breaking 540th TD pass (4 yards) in Paris, the Steelers' only touchdown in a 16-10 win over New Orleans.
101 rushing yards, his third 100-yard game this season and fourth with 125+ scrimmage yards (tied with Kenneth Walker III for most in the NFL). Leads the league with 360 yards after the catch.

Returned from a dislocated throwing-hand thumb that cost him three games and threw his 200th career TD pass (14 yards to Tez Johnson) in a 43-13 rout of Carolina. Wore a protective glove made by the Tampa Bay Rays.
106 rushing yards and 2 TDs on 24 carries with a season-high 73 yards after contact vs. Carolina.
Broke a 46-yard TD run in the fourth quarter vs. Carolina, on his 25th birthday.
Threw 2 INTs and only 163 yards at Tampa, snapping a streak of five straight 280+ yard games.
Caught a 50-yard TD from Bryce Young at Tampa.
Held to 33 yards on 7 carries at Tampa after 120+ yards in each of his previous two games.
Threw 3+ TDs with no INTs to beat the previously undefeated 49ers 29-20. NFL.com noted that kind of win over an unbeaten team puts him with Andrew Luck (2013) and Drew Brees (2018).
Scored a TD for the third straight game vs. San Francisco.
Caught his first TD of the season vs. San Francisco and was Penix's go-to target on third downs.
Scoreless first half, then went 16-of-18 for 249 yards and 4 TDs after halftime in a 35-13 win over Baltimore. Four TD passes tied his career high for a half.
6 catches, 148 yards and a TD vs. Baltimore.
5 catches, 62 yards and a TD vs. Baltimore. One TD away from 60 career receiving TDs.
Missed the 35-13 loss at Cincinnati with an injury; Tyler Huntley started and was sacked four times.
Held to 45 yards on 17 carries at Cincinnati, his second straight week under a 25% rushing success rate. Still 1 rushing TD from 130 for his career.
Ripped off a 35-yard scramble, his longest run of 2026, in a 16-10 win over Indianapolis.
Held to 108 passing yards (13-of-22) in a 16-10 loss at Minnesota; his late interception sealed it. The Colts fired GM Chris Ballard afterward.
95 rushing yards and a TD at Minnesota. Named in trade speculation after the Colts fired GM Chris Ballard.
Led Miami to its first win of the Jeff Hafley era and threw multiple TD passes for the first time this season, beating the Jets 28-25.
Rookie scored his first two NFL TDs, including a 63-yard catch-and-run, at the Jets.
103 yards and a TD on 25 carries at the Jets with De'Von Achane out.
Second straight 100-yard game, the first Jets rookie to do it since Al Toon in 1985, with two 50+ yard catches. Only the 12th player ever with two 100-yard games in his first three career games.
Caught 2 TDs on National Tight Ends Day vs. Miami.
Held to 2 catches for 26 yards vs. Miami; cameras caught him yelling at Geno Smith on the bench, though both denied it.
Threw an interception for the second straight game in a 28-25 loss to Miami.

Threw for 308 yards and led the game-winning drive at Tennessee. He's the third QB since the 1970 merger with a game-winning drive in each of his team's first five wins, after Troy Aikman (1990) and Matthew Stafford (2016).
Season highs with 96 rushing yards and 2 TDs at Tennessee.
Career-high 8 catches for 129 yards, all before halftime at Tennessee. He and Odell Beckham Jr. are the only rookies since 2000 with 8+ catches and 125+ yards in a first half.
Broke tackles on a 36-yard catch during the game-winning drive at Tennessee, two days after the anniversary of his sister's death.
129 rushing yards and 3 rushing TDs (155 scrimmage yards) in a 27-24 loss to Cleveland.
Lost a fumble forced by Tyson Campbell in the 27-24 loss to Cleveland.

62-yard TD run, the longest by a Broncos QB (Tim Tebow's 40-yarder in 2010) and the longest QB scramble TD in the Next Gen Stats era. Fifth QB ever with a 50+ yard passing TD and 50+ yard rushing TD in the same game.
Scored on a 52-yard screen pass at Arizona.
Waddle and Sutton combined for 7 catches and 93 yards at Arizona after Waddle was largely quiet for six weeks.

First TE in NFL history with 400 catches in his first five seasons, and the first player ever with 7+ catches in each of his team's first seven games. His 10th career 10-catch game is fifth-most by a TE.
Pressured on 50.9% of dropbacks in a 30-16 loss to Denver.
303 yards, 2 TDs, no INTs to beat Green Bay. His 14 TD passes without an interception through six games tie Russell Wilson (2019) for the most ever.
Lost a red-zone fumble vs. Green Bay.
274 yards, 2 TDs and an INT to Brian Branch in a 20-17 loss at Detroit.
91 scrimmage yards and a receiving TD at Detroit, but dropped a pass that would have been another touchdown.
Threw 3 TDs to become the Rams' all-time leader in TD passes (155, passing Roman Gabriel's 154). He also holds the Lions' record (282), the only player to lead two franchises.
Caught the 12-yard TD that made Stafford the Rams' all-time TD pass leader.
Caught 2 TDs on National Tight Ends Day, including the 5-yarder that tied Stafford's franchise record.
99 yards and a 17-yard TD on 16 carries at Las Vegas, but lost his second fumble of the season.
93 yards and a TD on 17 carries at Las Vegas.
Threw 2 TDs in a 35-21 loss to the Rams. The Raiders are reportedly weighing a switch to rookie Fernando Mendoza.
37-yard TD catch-and-run vs. the Rams; tied for the NFL lead with four 40+ yard catches.
Caught a 15-yard TD from Kirk Cousins vs. the Rams.

9 catches, 150 yards and a TD vs. KC, his sixth 100-yard game. Leads the NFL in catches, yards and receiving TDs, and is the third WR in the Super Bowl era with 800 scrimmage yards and 8 TDs through seven games (Cooper Kupp, Jerry Rice).
Threw a 28-yard TD to Jaxon Smith-Njigba but also a 64-yard pick-six in a 20-3 win over Kansas City.
100 rushing yards on 24 carries vs. Kansas City.
Had an unhappy return to Seattle, where he spent his first four seasons, in a 20-3 loss.
308 yards, 2 TDs and a 116.7 rating in a 30-24 Thursday win over New England, his second strong game since returning from a hamstring injury.
4 catches for 130 yards and a TD, all in the first half, vs. New England.
Season-high 7 catches for 69 yards and a TD vs. New England.
Three 21-yard catches on key fourth-quarter drives and recovered the onside kick that sealed the win over New England.
Carted off with a knee injury in the fourth quarter vs. New England; Ben Johnson said it didn't look good.
78 yards and a TD on 22 carries, outrushing the entire Patriots team, in Thursday's win.
24-of-31 for 321 yards, 2 TDs and an INT, plus a 7-yard rushing TD, in a 30-24 loss at Chicago.
Scored on a short catch-and-run with 3 seconds left in the first half at Chicago.
Caught a 30-yard TD from Drake Maye at Chicago.

258 yards, 1 TD and 2 INTs on 54 attempts (tied for his fourth-most ever) in a 23-13 loss at Green Bay, his second straight game with a passer rating under 70. He was slow to get up after a big second-quarter hit.
Scored on a 1-yard run at Green Bay, but Dallas managed only 48 rushing yards as a team.
Slipped on his break, leading to an interception at Green Bay; also converted a 17-yard catch on fourth down. Still 7 yards from 8,000 career receiving yards.
Caught a 6-yard TD with 52 seconds left at Green Bay, his first score of the season.
First non-Week 18 start of his career with Jalen Hurts on IR (blood clot): 26-of-45, 215 yards, 1 TD and 3 sacks in a 25-14 loss to Carolina, the Eagles' fourth straight loss.
Returned from a two-game hamstring absence and led the team with 7 catches for 75 yards and a 19-yard TD, his first score since Week 2. Ruled out for tonight with the hamstring again.
Drew an end-zone pass interference call that set up the Eagles' first TD vs. Carolina.
Hurt his right ankle on a 17-yard catch-and-run in the fourth quarter vs. Carolina; ruled out for tonight.
Scored on a 2-yard run vs. Carolina, his first TD since 2024.
Rookie had an early McKee pass deflect off his hands, nearly intercepted, vs. Carolina.
